% LM-HLLC contact wave (blended pressure jump)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C3-S-star-LM}
S_{\star} \;=\; \frac{f_{M}\,(P_{R} - P_{L}) \;+\; \rho_{L}\,u_{L}\,(S_{L} - u_{L}) \;-\; \rho_{R}\,u_{R}\,(S_{R} - u_{R})}{\rho_{L}\,(S_{L} - u_{L}) \;-\; \rho_{R}\,(S_{R} - u_{R})}

% Mach-based blend factor
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C3-fM}
f_{M} \;=\; \mathrm{clamp}\bigl(M_{\mathrm{local}},\; M_{\mathrm{cut}},\; 1\bigr),\qquad M_{\mathrm{local}} \;=\; \frac{|u_L| + |u_R|}{c_L + c_R},\qquad M_{\mathrm{cut}} \;=\; 10^{-3}

% M = 1 limit (recover standard HLLC)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C3-M1}
f_{M} \big|_{M = 1} \;=\; 1 \;\Longrightarrow\; S_{\star}^{\mathrm{LM}} = S_{\star}^{\mathrm{HLLC}}
\end{equation}

% Reflective-BC invariance (no pressure jump)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C3-reflective}
\text{under } \rho_L = \rho_R,\; u_L = -u_R,\; P_L = P_R \;\Longrightarrow\; P_R - P_L = 0 \;\Longrightarrow\; S_{\star}^{\mathrm{LM}} = S_{\star}^{\mathrm{HLLC}}
\end{equation}

% Low-Mach pressure-dissipation suppression
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C3-dispersion}
\text{dispersion ratio} \;\sim\; f_M \;\sim\; M \;\;\text{at low } M\qquad\text{(factor } M \text{ suppression relative to standard HLLC)}
